scripts.dev: concurrently -n WEB,API -c cyan,green "pnpm --dir apps/web dev" "pnpm --dir apps/api start:dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --dir apps/api build && pnpm --dir apps/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir apps/api exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --dir apps/web exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.quality: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:policy && pnpm run quality:policy && pnpm run audit:ci && pnpm run build
